title: Soft Skill Assessment - Set 1
description: Foundational placement readiness test evaluating core quantitative arithmetic, deductive logical reasoning, business English grammar, and workplace communication.

questions.question_text: If a product is bought for ₹450 and sold at a 20% profit, what is its selling price?
questions.explanation: Profit = 20% of ₹450 = 0.20 × 450 = ₹90. Selling Price = Cost Price + Profit = 450 + 90 = ₹540.

questions.question_text: The ratio of boys to girls in a class of 60 students is 3:2. How many girls are in the class?
questions.explanation: Total ratio parts = 3 + 2 = 5. Number of girls = (2/5) × 60 = 24.

questions.question_text: A train 150 metres long passes a telegraph pole in 10 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Speed in m/s = Distance / Time = 150 / 10 = 15 m/s. Converting to km/h: 15 × (18/5) = 54 km/h.

questions.question_text: Pipe A can fill a tank in 6 hours, while Pipe B can empty it in 8 hours. If both pipes are opened simultaneously, in how many hours will the tank be full?
questions.explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/6 - 1/8 = (4 - 3)/24 = 1/24. Thus, it will take 24 hours to fill the tank.

questions.question_text: The average of five consecutive integers is 28. What is the largest of these integers?
questions.explanation: For an odd number of consecutive integers, the average is the middle number. So the numbers are 26, 27, 28, 29, 30. The largest integer is 30.

questions.question_text: A sum of ₹12,000 invested at simple interest doubles in 8 years. What is the annual rate of interest?
questions.explanation: To double, the simple interest earned equals the principal P. P = (P × R × 8) / 100 => 8R = 100 => R = 12.5% per annum.

questions.question_text: A man buys 2 items for ₹900 each. He sells one at a 10% gain and the other at a 10% loss. What is his overall gain or loss percentage?
questions.explanation: Since both items have the SAME cost price (₹900 each), the gain of ₹90 on the first item exactly cancels the loss of ₹90 on the second item. Total cost = ₹1800, total selling price = ₹1800, so there is no profit and no loss.

questions.question_text: From a pack of 52 playing cards, two cards are drawn at random one after another without replacement. What is the probability that both are Aces?
questions.explanation: Probability of first Ace = 4/52 = 1/13. Probability of second Ace = 3/51 = 1/17. Combined probability = (1/13) × (1/17) = 1/221.

questions.question_text: Find the missing number in the sequence: 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, ?
questions.explanation: The numbers are consecutive squares: 2²=4, 3²=9, 4²=16, 5²=25, 6²=36, 7²=49.

questions.question_text: In a certain code, 'GLOVE' is written as 'INQXG'. How is 'SHIRT' written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2 positions: S(19)+2=U(21), H(8)+2=J(10), I(9)+2=K(11), R(18)+2=T(20), T(20)+2=V(22). The resulting word is UJKTV.

questions.question_text: Ananya walks 15 km North, turns right and walks 10 km, then turns right again and walks 15 km. In which direction and how far is she from her starting point?
questions.explanation: Her north and south movements (15 km north, then 15 km south) cancel out. Her sole lateral shift is 10 km east of the origin.

questions.question_text: Pointing towards a gentleman, Priya says, 'His only brother is the father of my daughter's father.' How is the gentleman related to Priya's husband?
questions.explanation: Priya's daughter's father is Priya's husband. The gentleman's only brother is Priya's husband's father. Therefore, the gentleman is the brother of Priya's husband's father, which makes him her husband's uncle.

questions.question_text: Select the related word pair: ARCHITECT : BUILDING :: ?
questions.explanation: An architect designs and creates a building; an author writes and creates a novel (Creator : Creation).

questions.question_text: Statements: All laptops are computers. Some computers are tablets. No tablet is a desktop. Conclusions: I. Some laptops are tablets. II. No desktop is a tablet.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
questions.explanation: Conclusion I cannot be deduced with certainty because laptops and tablets may be disjoint sets within computers. Conclusion II is the direct converse of 'No tablet is a desktop' and is definitely true.

questions.question_text: Find the odd one out among the given options: Copper, Bronze, Silver, Gold
questions.explanation: Copper, Silver, and Gold are pure chemical elements, whereas Bronze is an alloy (copper and tin).

questions.question_text: Choose the word that is nearest in meaning to 'PRAGMATIC':
questions.explanation: 'Pragmatic' means dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

questions.question_text: Identify the word that is opposite in meaning to 'EPHEMERAL':
questions.explanation: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time. Its direct antonym is 'Permanent'.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct sentence that observes standard grammatical rules of subject-verb agreement:
options: Neither the project manager nor the developers was present at the sync.
Neither the project manager nor the developers were present at the sync.
Neither the project manager nor the developers is present at the sync.
Neither the project manager nor the developers has been present at the sync.
questions.explanation: When compound subjects are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees in number with the closer subject ('developers' is plural, so 'were' is correct).

questions.question_text: Complete the phrase: The team decided to call ___ the release until all critical bugs were resolved.
questions.explanation: 'Call off' is a phrasal verb meaning to cancel or postpone an event or scheduled activity.

questions.question_text: What is the meaning of the idiom 'to burn the midnight oil'?
options: To work or study late into the night
questions.explanation: 'To burn the midnight oil' is an established idiom that means to work or study late into the night.

questions.question_text: Select the correct one-word substitution for: 'One who has an excessive enthusiasm for learning and books'
questions.explanation: A 'Bibliophile' is an individual who loves, seeks, and collects books. Philatelist collects stamps; Numismatist collects coins.

questions.question_text: You discover a critical bug in a core production service on Friday afternoon right before release. What is the most responsible action?
options: Deploy the release anyway and patch it on Monday morning.
Immediately notify the release lead and engineering team, provide steps to reproduce, and recommend halting or hotfixing the release.
Quietly push a fix without testing to avoid missing the deployment window.
Wait until someone else files a ticket to avoid getting blamed.
questions.explanation: Responsible engineering emphasizes transparency, reliability, and team communication over deploying known severe bugs to production.

questions.question_text: A senior engineer leaves harsh, dismissive comments on your pull request without technical justification. How should you respond?
options: Leave retaliatory comments on their recent pull requests.
Politely ask for clarification on the technical tradeoffs and schedule a brief 1-on-1 discussion to understand their concerns.
Complain to senior leadership immediately without talking to them.
Ignore their comments and merge the code directly.
questions.explanation: Professionalism requires de-escalating personal friction by focusing constructively on technical trade-offs and seeking direct clarifying dialogue.

questions.question_text: During daily standup, you realize you are blocked by an external API dependency that was promised yesterday. What is the best course of action?
options: Stay silent and browse tutorials until the dependency arrives.
Clearly report the blocker during standup, identify the impact on sprint goals, and collaborate with your lead to follow up with the partner team.
Start an unrelated personal side project without informing anyone.
Publicly criticize the partner team in an open company channel.
questions.explanation: Standups exist to highlight blockers early so the lead and team can unblock progress or adjust sprint commitments transparently.

questions.question_text: You notice that a peer on your sprint team is struggling with a complex architectural module and is falling behind schedule. How should you assist?
options: Complete their entire task for them without telling them how you did it.
Proactively offer a 30-minute pair-programming session to talk through the architecture and share relevant documentation.
Tell your manager that the peer is incompetent and should be replaced.
Keep working on your own backlog items and ignore their struggle.
questions.explanation: High-performing teams thrive on collaborative pair-programming and mentorship, which builds team capability without disempowering colleagues.

title: Soft Skill Assessment - Set 2
description: Evaluates commercial mathematical ability, logical relations, vocabulary in context, and professional accountability.

questions.question_text: A shopkeeper marks an item 40% above the cost price and then offers a 20% discount. What is his net profit percentage?
questions.explanation: Let CP = 100. Marked Price = 140. Selling Price = 140 × (1 - 0.20) = 140 × 0.80 = 112. Profit = 112 - 100 = 12%.

questions.question_text: A and B together can do a piece of work in 12 days, while B alone can do it in 30 days. In how many days can A alone complete the work?
questions.explanation: A's daily work rate = (1/12) - (1/30) = (5 - 2)/60 = 3/60 = 1/20. Therefore, A takes 20 days alone.

questions.question_text: Two numbers are in the ratio 4:7. If 6 is added to each number, the ratio becomes 2:3. What is the smaller number?
A boat travels 24 km downstream in 2 hours and takes 4 hours to travel the same distance upstream. What is the speed of the current?
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 24 / 2 = 12 km/h. Upstream speed = 24 / 4 = 6 km/h. Current speed = (Downstream - Upstream) / 2 = (12 - 6) / 2 = 3 km/h.

questions.question_text: What is the compound interest on ₹8,000 at 5% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually?
The price of petrol increased by 25%. By what percentage must a motorist reduce petrol consumption so as not to increase expenditure?
In how many distinct ways can the letters of the word 'LEADER' be arranged?
questions.explanation: Total letters = 6. The letter 'E' appears 2 times. Total arrangements = 6! / 2! = 720 / 2 = 360.

questions.question_text: A jar contains a mixture of milk and water in the ratio 3:1. If 4 litres of water is added, the ratio becomes 3:2. Find the initial quantity of milk in the jar.
questions.explanation: Let milk = 3x and water = x. After adding 4 litres of water: 3x / (x + 4) = 3/2 => 2(3x) = 3(x + 4) => 6x = 3x + 12 => 3x = 12 => x = 4. Quantity of milk = 3x = 12 litres.

questions.question_text: Complete the series: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, ?
questions.explanation: Differences between consecutive terms are odd numbers: +5, +7, +9, +11, +13. Next term = 35 + 13 = 48 (also n² - 1: 7² - 1 = 48).

questions.question_text: If 'WATER' is coded as 'XBUFS', how is 'EARTH' coded in the same language?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 1: E→F, A→B, R→S, T→U, H→I, giving FBSUI.

questions.question_text: Kavita ranks 8th from the top and 27th from the bottom in her college computer science cohort. How many students are in the cohort?
questions.explanation: Total students = (Rank from top) + (Rank from bottom) - 1 = 8 + 27 - 1 = 34.

questions.question_text: A man walks 6 km West, turns right and walks 8 km. How far is he from his initial starting point?
questions.explanation: Using Pythagoras theorem: Distance = √(6² + 8²) = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.question_text: Select the related pair: THERMOMETER : TEMPERATURE :: BAROMETER : ?
questions.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature; a barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.question_text: If P + Q means P is the mother of Q; P - Q means P is the sister of Q; P * Q means P is the father of Q. What does 'A * B - C' indicate?
options: A is the father of C
A is the uncle of C
A is the brother of C
A is the son of C
questions.explanation: A * B means A is the father of B. B - C means B is the sister of C. Since B and C are siblings, A is the father of both B and C.

questions.question_text: Find the odd one out: Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, Moon
questions.explanation: Mercury, Venus, and Jupiter are planets; the Moon is a natural satellite.

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym for 'CANDID':
questions.explanation: 'Candid' means truthful, straightforward, and frank in speech or expression.

questions.question_text: Choose the antonym for 'BENEVOLENT':
questions.explanation: 'Benevolent' means well-meaning and kindly. Its direct antonym is 'Malevolent' (wishing evil or harm).

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: The manager congratulated Sarah ___ her promotion to tech lead.
questions.explanation: The standard preposition paired with 'congratulate' is 'on' (congratulate someone on something).

questions.question_text: Select the sentence with correct punctuation:
options: The server crashed because of high traffic, however the backup restored it.
The server crashed because of high traffic; however, the backup restored it.
The server crashed because of high traffic, however, the backup restored it.
The server crashed because of high traffic; however the backup restored it.
questions.explanation: When joining two independent clauses with the conjunctive adverb 'however', use a semicolon before 'however' and a comma after it.

questions.question_text: Choose the option that correctly describes the meaning of 'AMBIGUOUS':
options: Open to more than one interpretation
questions.explanation: 'Ambiguous' refers to language or information that is open to more than one interpretation or lacks clarity.

questions.question_text: What does the idiom 'bite the bullet' mean?
options: To engage in a dangerous armed combat
To face a difficult situation with courage and endurance
To make a reckless and impulsive decision
To waste time on trivial arguments
questions.explanation: 'Bite the bullet' means to bravely endure a painful or unavoidable situation.

questions.question_text: A client requests a significant new feature during a sprint without updating the project scope or timeline. What should you do?
options: Work unpaid weekends secretly to build it without informing management.
Politely acknowledge the client's request, explain the change management process, and redirect them to the Product Manager for roadmap estimation.
Rudely tell the client that their request is out of scope and decline to talk further.
Immediately agree to deliver it by tomorrow without assessing feasibility.
questions.explanation: Scope creep must be managed professionally by acknowledging client needs while steering them through proper product estimation and scheduling channels.

questions.question_text: You accidentally drop a production database table during an off-hours schema migration. What is the correct immediate step?
options: Shut down your laptop and hope the morning shift fixes it.
Immediately alert the infrastructure team and engineering lead, explain what happened accurately, and assist in initiating the backup recovery plan.
Try to rebuild the table from memory without notifying anyone.
Blame an automated scheduled cron job.
questions.explanation: Immediate ownership, transparency, and rapid collaboration minimize production downtime and protect user trust.

questions.question_text: In a team brainstorming session, your idea is chosen over an idea suggested by a colleague, and the colleague appears visibly upset. What should you do?
options: Boast loudly about how superior your technical proposal was.
Approach the colleague privately after the meeting, acknowledge the strengths of their proposal, and explore ways to incorporate their key insights.
Complain to HR that the colleague has an attitude problem.
Ignore them completely and avoid speaking to them in the future.
questions.explanation: Empathetic collaboration and privately validating teammates' ideas builds psychological safety and stronger cross-functional solutions.

questions.question_text: You are assigned to evaluate two third-party libraries for payment processing. One is built by your close friend's startup, but the other clearly has better security and documentation. Which do you recommend?
options: Recommend your friend's startup library regardless of technical drawbacks.
Conduct an objective comparative analysis based on security, uptime, latency, and documentation, and recommend the superior library with clear data.
Refuse to do the evaluation to avoid any personal dilemmas.
Secretly modify the benchmark results to favor your friend.
questions.explanation: Engineering integrity requires unbiased, data-backed technical evaluations that prioritize system security and corporate reliability.

title: Soft Skill Assessment - Set 3
description: Tests numerical agility, pattern analysis, verbal clarity, and conflict de-escalation in high-stakes corporate environments.

questions.question_text: A train 240 m long crosses a platform of equal length in 24 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Total distance = Train length + Platform length = 240 + 240 = 480 m. Speed = 480 / 24 = 20 m/s. In km/h: 20 × (18/5) = 72 km/h.

questions.question_text: The average age of a committee of 8 members is unchanged when an old member is replaced by a new member who is 24 years younger than the old member. How many years ago was the replacement discussed? (Alternative standard problem: A man replaces an old member aged 50 with a person aged 26. What was the reduction in total age? 24 years, so average dropped by 3 years). Let's use the standard: 'The average age of 8 men increases by 2 years when two women replace two men whose ages are 21 and 23. What is the average age of the two women?'
questions.explanation: Sum of ages of two men replaced = 21 + 23 = 44. Since the average of 8 people increases by 2, total age increases by 8 × 2 = 16. Sum of ages of two women = 44 + 16 = 60. Average age of the two women = 60 / 2 = 30 years.

questions.question_text: If 15 men can complete a project in 20 days, how many days will 25 men take to complete the same project?
questions.explanation: Total work = 15 men × 20 days = 300 man-days. With 25 men: Time = 300 / 25 = 12 days.

questions.question_text: A sum of money placed at compound interest doubles itself in 4 years. In how many years will it amount to 8 times itself at the same rate?
questions.explanation: Under compound interest, if an amount becomes 2^1 times in 4 years, it becomes 8 = 2^3 times in 3 × 4 = 12 years.

questions.question_text: Find the HCF of 72, 108, and 180.
questions.explanation: 72 = 36 × 2, 108 = 36 × 3, 180 = 36 × 5. The greatest common factor of 72, 108, and 180 is 36.

questions.question_text: A bag contains 5 red, 4 green, and 3 blue balls. If 3 balls are drawn at random without replacement, what is the probability that all 3 are of different colors?
questions.explanation: Total balls = 12. Total ways to choose 3 balls = 12C3 = (12 × 11 × 10) / (3 × 2 × 1) = 220. Ways to pick 1 ball of each color = 5C1 × 4C1 × 3C1 = 5 × 4 × 3 = 60. Probability = 60 / 220 = 3/11.

questions.question_text: A merchant professes to sell his goods at cost price, but uses a false weight of 950 grams for a kilogram. What is his actual gain percentage?
What is the simple interest on ₹7,500 at 6% per annum for 3 years?
Complete the letter series: Z, X, V, T, R, ?
questions.explanation: The series steps backward by 2 letters in the alphabet: Z(26), X(24), V(22), T(20), R(18), P(16).

questions.question_text: In a coding system, if 'DELHI' is 73541 and 'CALCUTTA' is 82589662, how is 'CALICUT' coded?
questions.explanation: Direct letter substitution: C=8, A=2, L=5, I=1, C=8, U=9, T=6. Assembling CALICUT gives 8251896.

questions.question_text: Pointing to a man, a woman said, 'His mother's only son is my father.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: 'His mother's only son' is the man himself. Since the man is the woman's father, the woman is his daughter.

questions.question_text: A clock shows 3:00. What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand?
questions.explanation: At 3:00, the minute hand points at 12 and the hour hand points at 3. The separation is 3 hour spaces = 3 × 30° = 90°.

questions.question_text: Statements: All cars are vehicles. No vehicle is an airplane. All airplanes are flying machines. Which conclusions follow? I. No car is an airplane. II. Some flying machines are airplanes.
questions.explanation: Since all cars are vehicles and no vehicle is an airplane, no car can be an airplane (I follows). Since all airplanes are flying machines, some flying machines are airplanes (II follows).

questions.question_text: Find the odd one out: 64, 125, 216, 343, 512, 720
If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West, and so on, what will West become?
questions.explanation: South-East (135°) becomes North (0°/360°), which is a 135° rotation anticlockwise. Applying a 135° anticlockwise rotation to West (270°) leads to South-East (135°).

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym of 'METICULOUS':
questions.explanation: 'Meticulous' means showing extreme care and precision in details; closest to 'Careful'.

questions.question_text: Choose the antonym of 'OBSOLETE':
questions.explanation: 'Obsolete' means no longer produced or used (out of date). Its direct antonym is 'Contemporary' (modern, current).

questions.question_text: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood?
options: If I was the engineering director, I would restructure the platform.
If I were the engineering director, I would restructure the platform.
If I am the engineering director, I would restructure the platform.
If I will be the engineering director, I would restructure the platform.
questions.explanation: Hypothetical counterfactual statements require the subjunctive 'were' rather than 'was' (If I were...).

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: She has been working at the company ___ 2021.
questions.explanation: Use 'since' with a specific point in time (2021) in the present perfect continuous tense.

questions.question_text: What does the idiom 'the ball is in your court' mean?
options: It is your turn to take action or make a decision
You have lost the tennis game
questions.explanation: 'The ball is in your court' signifies that it is now someone's responsibility to make the next move.

questions.question_text: Select the one-word substitution for: 'A speech delivered without any prior preparation'
questions.explanation: 'Extempore' refers to a speech or presentation delivered impromptu without advance preparation.

questions.question_text: A junior engineer accidentally commits API credentials and database passwords into a public repository. What should you instruct them to do immediately?
options: Delete the commit message and pretend it didn't happen.
Immediately revoke and rotate the exposed credentials, notify security, and remove the secret from git history using proper tools.
Close the repository to private and do nothing else.
Scold the junior in front of the entire team channel.
questions.explanation: Once credentials touch a public repository, they must be considered compromised. Revoking and rotating them is the only secure immediate response.

questions.question_text: You notice that two senior engineers on your squad disagree strongly on an architectural pattern, causing a project standstill. How can you help unblock the team?
options: Pick a side based on who you like more personally.
Suggest building a timeboxed Proof of Concept (PoC) for both patterns to objectively benchmark latency, maintenance, and developer velocity.
Tell both engineers to stop arguing and let the product manager write the code.
Escalate to HR for disciplinary action.
questions.explanation: Empirical data from a timeboxed Proof of Concept transforms opinion-based debates into factual, criteria-based technical decisions.

questions.question_text: You realize you have committed to two simultaneous customer-facing presentation meetings tomorrow morning. What is the most professional response?
options: Attend one and quietly miss the other without saying anything.
Proactively notify both organizers immediately, explain the scheduling conflict honestly, and arrange a qualified delegate or reschedule well in advance.
Cancel both meetings at the last minute.
Log into both calls on mute and alternate speaking randomly.
questions.explanation: Early, proactive communication and organizing backup coverage demonstrates professional respect for clients' time.

questions.question_text: During an interview for a promotion, you are asked about a project failure where your team missed a key deadline. What is the most impressive way to answer?
options: Blame external vendors and junior teammates for the delay.
Explain the context transparently, own your personal role in the outcome, describe the retrospective root-cause analysis, and highlight systemic improvements implemented since.
Claim that the project actually succeeded and denial is best.
Say you have never failed at anything in your professional career.
questions.explanation: Executive maturity is shown through accountability, post-mortem retrospectives, and demonstrating systemic growth from setbacks.

title: Soft Skill Assessment - Set 4
description: Comprehensive evaluation covering speed mathematics, spatial and alphanumeric logic, grammatical precision, and stakeholder communication.

questions.question_text: If 20% of a number is 80, what is 35% of that same number?
A car covers a distance of 450 km at a certain uniform speed. If its speed had been 15 km/h more, it would have taken 1.5 hours less. What was its original speed?
questions.explanation: Let original speed be v. 450/v - 450/(v + 15) = 1.5. Testing v = 60: 450/60 = 7.5 hours. 450/75 = 6 hours. Difference = 7.5 - 6 = 1.5 hours. Thus, original speed = 60 km/h.

questions.question_text: In what ratio should coffee powder costing ₹180/kg be mixed with coffee powder costing ₹260/kg so that the resulting mixture is worth ₹210/kg?
A vendor buys lemons at 6 for ₹10 and sells them at 4 for ₹10. What is his profit percentage?
questions.explanation: Cost of 12 lemons (LCM of 6 and 4) = 2 × 10 = ₹20. Selling price of 12 lemons = 3 × 10 = ₹30. Profit = ₹10 on ₹20 = 50%.

questions.question_text: The simple interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹500. What would be the compound interest on the same sum at the same rate and for the same time?
questions.explanation: SI for 2 years = ₹500, so SI per year = ₹250. Principal = (250 × 100) / 10 = ₹2500. For CI: First year interest = ₹250. Second year interest = 250 + (10% of 250) = 250 + 25 = ₹275. Total CI = 250 + 275 = ₹525.

questions.question_text: The perimeter of a square is 48 cm. What is the area of the square?
questions.explanation: Side of square = 48 / 4 = 12 cm. Area = side² = 12 × 12 = 144 cm².

questions.question_text: In a group of 6 men and 4 women, a committee of 4 persons is to be formed. In how many ways can this be done such that at least one woman is included?
questions.explanation: Total ways to choose 4 from 10 = 10C4 = (10 × 9 × 8 × 7) / (4 × 3 × 2 × 1) = 210. Ways with NO women (all 4 are men) = 6C4 = 15. Ways with at least one woman = 210 - 15 = 195.

questions.question_text: Two pipes can fill a cistern in 14 hours and 16 hours respectively. The pipes are opened simultaneously and it is found that due to leakage in the bottom, it took 32 minutes more to fill the cistern. When the cistern is full, in how much time will the leak empty it?
questions.explanation: Combined fill rate = 1/14 + 1/16 = 15/112 tank/hr. Normal time = 112/15 hr = 7 hr 28 min. With leak, time = 7 hr 28 min + 32 min = 8 hours. Net rate with leak = 1/8. Leak emptying rate = 15/112 - 1/8 = 15/112 - 14/112 = 1/112. The leak will empty the full cistern in 112 hours.

questions.question_text: Find the next number in the pattern: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
If 'SYSTEM' is coded as 'SYSMET' and 'NEARER' is coded as 'AENRER', how is 'FRACTION' coded?
questions.explanation: Split FRACTION into two 4-letter segments: 'FRAC' and 'TION'. Reverse each segment: 'FRAC' becomes 'CARF' and 'TION' becomes 'NOIT', yielding CARFNOIT.

questions.question_text: Introducing a boy, a girl said, 'He is the son of the daughter of the father of my uncle.' How is the boy related to the girl?
questions.explanation: Father of my uncle = my grandfather. Daughter of my grandfather = my mother (or aunt). Son of my mother = my brother.

questions.question_text: LIGHT : DARKNESS :: KNOWLEDGE : ?
questions.explanation: Light is the direct opposite of Darkness; Knowledge is the direct opposite of Ignorance.

questions.question_text: Five executives P, Q, R, S, and T sit in a row facing North. S sits between T and Q. Q is to the immediate left of R. P is to the immediate left of T. Who sits in the middle?
questions.explanation: Arrangement from left to right: P, T, S, Q, R. S is exactly in the center position.

questions.question_text: A man starts from point A and walks 4 km South, then turns left and walks 3 km to point B. What is the shortest distance between point A and point B?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(4² + 3²) = √(16 + 9) = √25 = 5 km.

questions.question_text: Find the odd one out: Inch, Foot, Yard, Acre
questions.explanation: Inch, Foot, and Yard are linear units of length, whereas Acre is a unit of area.

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym of 'LUCID':
questions.explanation: 'Lucid' means expressed clearly and easy to understand; closest to 'Clear'.

questions.question_text: Choose the antonym of 'AUSTERE':
questions.explanation: 'Austere' means plain, severe, and strict without comfort. Its antonym is 'Luxurious'.

questions.question_text: Spot the error in the following sentence: 'Each of the candidates have submitted their portfolio on time.'
questions.explanation: 'Each' is an indefinite pronoun that takes a singular verb: 'has submitted', not 'have submitted'.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: The team had to abstain ___ making public statements until the audit was complete.
questions.explanation: The verb 'abstain' is properly followed by the preposition 'from' (abstain from something).

questions.question_text: What does the idiom 'hit the nail on the head' mean?
options: To state or describe something with exact precision
To fail miserably at an exam
questions.explanation: 'Hit the nail on the head' means to accurately identify or describe the exact cause or truth of a situation.

questions.question_text: Select the correct one-word substitution: 'A person who regards the whole world as their country'
questions.explanation: A 'Cosmopolitan' person is familiar with and at home in many different countries and cultures.

questions.question_text: Your team leader is consistently allocating all high-visibility architectural tasks to one preferred team member, leaving repetitive bugs to others. What is the most mature response?
options: Publicly accuse the team leader of favoritism during an all-hands meeting.
Schedule a 1-on-1 with your team leader to discuss your career growth goals, express your interest in architectural work, and propose taking on a sub-module.
Quietly stop fixing bugs to sabotage team metrics.
Gossip with other departments about your leader.
questions.explanation: Direct 1-on-1 professional communication focused on your personal aspirations and offering concrete ways to contribute is constructive and effective.

questions.question_text: You are leading a customer demo and the live staging server suddenly throws an unhandled 500 error on the main dashboard. How should you react?
options: Panic and abruptly end the video call.
Remain calm, acknowledge the glitch honestly, explain the scenario professionally, transition to backup demo slides or recorded flows, and have the team investigate.
Blame your junior QA engineer by name on the call.
Pretend the error is an intended security feature.
questions.explanation: Composure under pressure, transparent communication, and having a ready fallback plan demonstrate poise and senior leadership presence.

questions.question_text: A teammate sends an urgent email asking for your assistance while you are heads-down finishing a critical deploy before a hard deadline in 30 minutes. What should you do?
options: Ignore their message completely for the rest of the day.
Send a brief, polite acknowledgment stating you are completing a high-priority deploy right now and will assist them right after in 30 minutes.
Reply angrily telling them never to disturb you.
Drop your deploy immediately and let the deployment fail.
questions.explanation: Timely acknowledgment with realistic boundary setting informs the teammate without derailing urgent delivery commitments.

questions.question_text: During user interviews, several enterprise users strongly criticize an interface component you spent two months designing. How should you receive this feedback?
options: Take it personally and argue that the users don't understand modern design.
View the feedback objectively as vital user research data, ask clarifying questions about their pain points, and synthesize the insights to iterate.
Ignore the users and keep the interface unchanged.
Resign from the team out of frustration.
questions.explanation: User feedback is essential data for product improvement; receiving it objectively without defensiveness leads to world-class software.

title: Soft Skill Assessment - Set 5
description: Comprehensive corporate mock assessment testing proportional reasoning, blood relationships, syntax mastery, and cross-team ethics.

questions.question_text: A sum of ₹10,000 is invested partly at 8% and partly at 10% per annum simple interest. If the total annual interest is ₹920, how much money was invested at 8%?
The average weight of 24 students in a class is 45 kg. If the weight of the teacher is included, the average increases by 1 kg. What is the weight of the teacher?
questions.explanation: Teacher's weight = New average + (Original count × increase) = 46 + (24 × 1) = 46 + 24 = 70 kg.

questions.question_text: A tap can fill a tank in 20 minutes, while another tap can fill it in 30 minutes. If both taps are opened together, how long will it take to fill the tank?
questions.explanation: Combined rate = 1/20 + 1/30 = (3 + 2)/60 = 5/60 = 1/12 tank/min. Time taken = 12 minutes.

questions.question_text: The population of a city is 160,000. If it increases at the rate of 5% per annum, what will be its population after 2 years?
Two numbers are in the ratio 5:8. If their difference is 48, what is the sum of the two numbers?
questions.explanation: Let numbers be 5x and 8x. Difference = 8x - 5x = 3x = 48 => x = 16. Sum = 5x + 8x = 13x = 13 × 16 = 208.

questions.question_text: A man can row 9 km/h in still water. If the river runs at 3 km/h, it takes him 3 hours to row to a place and row back. How far is the place?
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 9 + 3 = 12 km/h. Upstream speed = 9 - 3 = 6 km/h. Time = d/12 + d/6 = 3 => (d + 2d)/12 = 3 => 3d = 36 => d = 12 km.

questions.question_text: What is the remainder when 7^84 is divided by 342?
questions.explanation: 7³ = 343 = 342 + 1. So 7^84 = (7³)^28 = (342 + 1)^28. By the binomial theorem, every term except 1^28 is a multiple of 342. Remainder = 1.

questions.question_text: By selling a bicycle for ₹2,850, a dealer gains 14%. What was the cost price of the bicycle?
Find the missing number: 6, 11, 21, 36, 56, ?
questions.explanation: Differences: +5, +10, +15, +20, +25. Next number = 56 + 25 = 81.

questions.question_text: If 'ORANGE' is coded as 'PSBOHF', how is 'BANANA' coded in the same scheme?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 1: B→C, A→B, N→O, A→B, N→O, A→B, producing CBOBOB.

questions.question_text: Looking at a family portrait, Rohan says, 'Her mother is the only daughter of my wife's mother.' How is Rohan related to the girl in the portrait?
questions.explanation: The only daughter of Rohan's wife's mother is Rohan's wife herself. So the girl's mother is Rohan's wife, which makes Rohan the girl's father.

questions.question_text: Rakesh walks 20 m North, then turns right and walks 30 m, then turns right and walks 35 m, then turns left and walks 15 m. In which direction is he from his starting position?
questions.explanation: Vertical shift: +20 m North - 35 m South = -15 m (South). Horizontal shift: +30 m East + 15 m East = +45 m (East). He is South-East of his start.

questions.question_text: Select the related pair: CALENDAR : DATES :: DICTIONARY : ?
questions.explanation: A calendar is an indexed reference of dates; a dictionary is an indexed reference of words.

questions.question_text: Statements: Some phones are watches. All watches are calculators. Conclusions: I. Some calculators are phones. II. Some calculators are watches.
questions.explanation: Since some phones are watches and all watches are calculators, those phones are calculators (I follows). Since all watches are calculators, some calculators must be watches (II follows). Both conclusions follow.

questions.question_text: Find the odd one out: 13, 17, 23, 27, 31
questions.explanation: 13, 17, 23, and 31 are prime numbers, whereas 27 is a composite number (3³).

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym of 'TENACIOUS':
questions.explanation: 'Tenacious' means holding fast, persistent, and determined; closest to 'Persistent'.

questions.question_text: Choose the antonym of 'CONCISE':
questions.explanation: 'Concise' means brief and comprehensive. Its direct antonym is 'Wordy' (or verbose).

questions.question_text: Select the correctly spelled word:
questions.explanation: 'Accommodate' has two 'c's and two 'm's.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: The team was not only efficient ___ remarkably creative in their problem solving.
questions.explanation: The correlative conjunction 'not only' must be paired with 'but also'.

questions.question_text: What is the meaning of the idiom 'to spill the beans'?
questions.explanation: 'To spill the beans' means to reveal secret information, often unintentionally.

questions.question_text: Select the one-word substitution for: 'A person who is indifferent to pleasure or pain'
questions.explanation: A 'Stoic' is an individual who can endure pain or hardship without showing feelings or complaining.

questions.question_text: You discover that a competitor has accidentally exposed confidential client roadmaps on an open web bucket. What is the ethical course of action?
options: Download all files and share them with your marketing team to poach clients.
Notify your internal security and legal team, and practice ethical vulnerability disclosure to alert the competitor's security point of contact without exploiting the data.
Post the data anonymously on public forums.
questions.explanation: High-integrity enterprise ethics mandate responsible disclosure and strict compliance without illegal exploitation of leaked competitor data.

questions.question_text: A new product manager frequently alters user stories mid-sprint without team consensus, causing team burnout and missed commitments. What is the most constructive response?
options: Refuse to talk to the product manager entirely.
Raise the pattern objectively in the sprint retrospective, present data on sprint velocity disruption, and agree on sprint freeze guidelines for new requirements.
Submit low quality code to meet the deadlines anyway.
Complain to clients about internal friction.
questions.explanation: The sprint retrospective is the designated agile forum to discuss process bottlenecks constructively with factual velocity data.

questions.question_text: You are asked to mentor an intern for two months. How should you structure your mentoring time to ensure their success?
options: Give them manual documentation tasks and tell them not to disturb you.
Set clear weekly learning milestones, schedule a recurring 20-minute daily check-in, provide prompt feedback, and guide them toward self-sufficiency.
Do all of their assigned tasks yourself so the team looks good.
Ask them to fetch coffee and lunches.
questions.explanation: Effective mentorship requires structured learning milestones, regular supportive check-ins, and constructive feedback.

questions.question_text: Your team's software release fails quality benchmarks on staging the night before an executive board demonstration. The VP asks if you can bypass the test suite to present. What should you recommend?
options: Bypass all tests immediately and hide the failures from the board.
Advise against bypassing safety checks due to high risk of catastrophic failure during the demo; instead, propose presenting the stable tested baseline modules with transparent disclosures.
Turn off your phone and refuse to answer the VP.
Falsify test reports to show 100% green.
questions.explanation: Protecting platform integrity and providing transparent executive risk counsel is the hallmark of trustworthy engineering leadership.

title: Soft Skill Assessment - Set 6
description: Evaluates advanced algorithmic mathematics, deductive reasoning, corporate verbal synthesis, and team sprint velocity management.

questions.question_text: A man invested ₹50,000 in two mutual funds. One pays 12% annual interest and the other pays 15%. If his total annual return is ₹6,900, how much did he invest at 12%?
If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 22 seconds, what is the length of the train?
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance in 22 s = 20 × 22 = 440 m. Train length = 440 - 200 = 240 m.

questions.question_text: A can do a piece of work in 15 days and B in 20 days. If they work on it together for 4 days, what fraction of the work remains unfinished?
questions.explanation: Work done in 1 day = 1/15 + 1/20 = 7/60. Work done in 4 days = 4 × (7/60) = 28/60 = 7/15. Unfinished fraction = 1 - 7/15 = 8/15.

questions.question_text: In a mixture of 60 litres, the ratio of milk and water is 2:1. What quantity of water must be added to make the ratio 1:2?
questions.explanation: Milk = (2/3) × 60 = 40 litres, Water = 20 litres. To have Milk:Water = 1:2, water needed = 2 × 40 = 80 litres. Additional water = 80 - 20 = 60 litres.

questions.question_text: In how many ways can 5 boys and 4 girls sit in a row so that no two girls are together?
questions.explanation: First seat the 5 boys: 5! = 120 ways. This creates 6 available gaps (__ B1 __ B2 __ B3 __ B4 __ B5 __). Choose 4 gaps for the 4 girls: 6P4 = 6 × 5 × 4 × 3 = 360 ways. Total arrangements = 120 × 360 = 43,200.

questions.question_text: The price of sugar drops by 10%. By what percentage can a household increase its sugar consumption without changing expenditure?
Find the compound interest on ₹16,000 for 1.5 years at 10% per annum, compounded half-yearly.
What is the least number which when divided by 6, 9, 12, and 15 leaves a remainder of 3 in each case?
questions.explanation: LCM(6, 9, 12, 15) = 180. Required number = LCM + remainder = 180 + 3 = 183.

questions.question_text: Find the missing term: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, ?
questions.explanation: Consecutive cubes: 1³=1, 2³=8, 3³=27, 4³=64, 5³=125, 6³=216.

questions.question_text: In a certain code, 'STABLE' is written as '192012125'. How is 'CABIN' written in that scheme?
questions.explanation: Letters are replaced with alphabetical positions: C=3, A=1, B=2, I=9, N=14. The code is 312914.

questions.question_text: Deepak is the brother of Ravi. Rekha is the sister of Atul. Ravi is the son of Rekha. How is Deepak related to Rekha?
questions.explanation: Since Ravi is Rekha's son, and Deepak is Ravi's brother, Deepak must also be Rekha's son.

questions.question_text: Six friends A, B, C, D, E, and F sit around a circular table facing the centre. A is opposite to D. B is to the immediate right of A. C is between A and F. Who is opposite to B?
questions.explanation: Circular order clockwise: A, B, E, D, F, C. A is opposite D. B is opposite E. C is opposite F. Thus, the person opposite B is E.

questions.question_text: HORSE : FOAL :: SWAN : ?
questions.explanation: A young horse is a foal; a young swan is a cygnet.

questions.question_text: A boy travels 10 km South, turns left and travels 15 km, turns left again and travels 10 km. How far is he from his starting point?
questions.explanation: The south and north 10 km legs cancel out, leaving him exactly 15 km East of his origin.

questions.question_text: Find the odd one out: Square, Rectangle, Rhombus, Cylinder
questions.explanation: Square, Rectangle, and Rhombus are 2D polygons; Cylinder is a 3D geometric solid.

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym of 'ARTICULATE':
questions.explanation: 'Articulate' means able to express thoughts and ideas clearly and effectively; closest to 'Coherent'.

questions.question_text: Choose the antonym of 'RESILIENT':
questions.explanation: 'Resilient' means able to recoil or spring back into shape after bending or stretching. Its antonym is 'Fragile'.

questions.question_text: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Scarcely had the deployment completed when the alerting system triggered.
Scarcely had the deployment completed than the alerting system triggered.
Scarcely the deployment had completed when the alerting system triggered.
Scarcely did the deployment completed when the alerting system triggered.
questions.explanation: 'Scarcely... when' is the correct correlative conjunction pairing with subject-auxiliary inversion (had the deployment completed).

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: The senior architect did not agree ___ the proposed database sharding strategy.
questions.explanation: One agrees 'with' a person or viewpoint, and agrees 'to' a formal proposal/demand. Here, agreeing with the proposed strategy represents shared consensus.

questions.question_text: What does the idiom 'to cut corners' mean?
options: To take a shortcut across an intersection
To do something perfunctorily or cheaply in order to save time or money
To solve a complex problem smartly
questions.explanation: 'To cut corners' means to do something in the easiest, cheapest, or fastest way, often sacrificing quality or safety.

questions.question_text: Select the one-word substitution for: 'A remedy for all diseases or problems'
questions.explanation: A 'Panacea' is a universal remedy or solution for all diseases or difficulties.

questions.question_text: You realize that your team's upcoming feature will store unencrypted user credit card numbers in logs to ease debugging. What should you do?
options: Ignore it because developer convenience speeds up feature delivery.
Immediately raise a P0 security vulnerability, explain PCI-DSS compliance regulations to the team, and implement log masking before deployment.
Wait until an external auditor catches it next year.
Only log card numbers for non-VIP users.
questions.explanation: Storing unencrypted financial data violates compliance (PCI-DSS) and severely risks customer privacy. Immediate masking and security escalation is non-negotiable.

questions.question_text: A teammate repeatedly misses daily standups and fails to reply on Slack during core collaboration hours. How should you address this?
options: Rant about their absence publicly in the main company watercooler channel.
Check in with them privately in a friendly, supportive manner to see if they are facing personal challenges, while reiterating team communication expectations.
Remove them from the code repository permissions quietly.
Ignore the issue completely until the sprint fails.
questions.explanation: Checking in privately with empathy uncovers root causes while constructively reinforcing team commitments without public humiliation.

questions.question_text: You are invited to present at a prestigious engineering conference, but the dates conflict with a scheduled sprint release. How should you proceed?
options: Skip the sprint release without telling anyone.
Discuss the opportunity with your engineering manager in advance, arrange full sprint handoffs, and agree on a plan that safeguards project delivery.
Decline the conference immediately without consulting your manager.
Secretly work remotely from the conference while pretending to be at home.
questions.explanation: Proactive planning and transparent collaboration allow professionals to pursue growth opportunities while ensuring team accountability.

questions.question_text: During code review, you find an elegant algorithm written by a peer that solves an intractable bottleneck. What is the best way to acknowledge this?
options: Copy the code into your own file and submit it under your name.
Leave a glowing review praising their creative engineering, approve the PR, and highlight their contribution in the team engineering demo.
Approve silently without giving any positive feedback.
Find minor styling nitpicks to downplay their achievement.
questions.explanation: A strong engineering culture celebrates peer excellence and publicly recognizes outstanding technical achievements.

title: Soft Skill Assessment - Set 7
description: Tests probability, analytical geometry, logical deductions, nuanced business writing, and client escalation protocols.

questions.question_text: A box contains 4 black balls and 6 white balls. If two balls are drawn at random without replacement, what is the probability that both are white?
questions.explanation: Probability of first white = 6/10. Probability of second white = 5/9. Combined = (6/10) × (5/9) = 30/90 = 1/3.

questions.question_text: The length of a rectangular field is twice its breadth. If the area of the field is 288 m², what is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Let breadth = b, length = 2b. Area = 2b² = 288 => b² = 144 => b = 12 m. Length = 24 m. Perimeter = 2(24 + 12) = 2 × 36 = 72 m.

questions.question_text: A dealer sells a watch for ₹1,440 and loses 10%. At what price should he sell it to gain 15%?
A motorboat takes 6 hours to travel 36 km upstream and 3 hours to travel the same distance downstream. Find the speed of the motorboat in still water.
questions.explanation: Upstream speed = 36 / 6 = 6 km/h. Downstream speed = 36 / 3 = 12 km/h. Boat speed in still water = (12 + 6) / 2 = 9 km/h.

questions.question_text: The average of 7 numbers is 18. If one number is excluded, their average becomes 16. What is the excluded number?
questions.explanation: Sum of 7 = 7 × 18 = 126. Sum of remaining 6 = 6 × 16 = 96. Excluded number = 126 - 96 = 30.

questions.question_text: In how many ways can 6 people be seated around a circular dining table?
questions.explanation: Number of circular permutations of n items = (n - 1)!. For 6 people: (6 - 1)! = 5! = 120.

questions.question_text: A cistern has two pipes. One can fill it with water in 8 hours and other can empty it in 5 hours. In how many hours will the cistern be emptied if both pipes are opened together when 3/4 of the cistern is already full of water?
questions.explanation: Net emptying rate = 1/5 - 1/8 = 3/40 tank/hr. To empty 3/4 of the tank: Time = (3/4) / (3/40) = (3/4) × (40/3) = 10 hours.

questions.question_text: Find the simple interest on ₹4,800 at 7.5% per annum for 4 years.
Complete the series: 7, 10, 16, 25, 37, ?
questions.explanation: Differences: +3, +6, +9, +12, +15. Next term = 37 + 15 = 52.

questions.question_text: If 'TEACHER' is coded as 'VGCEJGT', how is 'CHILDREN' coded in the same pattern?
questions.explanation: Each letter shifted +2: C→E, H→J, I→K, L→N, D→F, R→T, E→G, N→P = EJKNFTGP.

questions.question_text: A clock shows 6:30. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
questions.explanation: At 6:30, minute hand is at 6. Hour hand is at 6 + (30/60) hour = 6.5. Separation = 0.5 × 30° = 15°.

questions.question_text: Statements: All flowers are trees. No tree is a fruit. Some fruits are roots. Conclusions: I. No flower is a fruit. II. Some roots are not trees.
questions.explanation: Since all flowers are trees and no tree is a fruit, no flower can be a fruit (I follows). Since some roots are fruits and no fruit is a tree, those root-fruits cannot be trees (II follows). Both follow.

questions.question_text: PUPIL : EYE :: COCHLEA : ?
questions.explanation: The pupil is an anatomical structure of the eye; the cochlea is an anatomical structure of the inner ear.

questions.question_text: In a row of trees, one tree is the 7th from either end of the row. How many trees are in the row?
questions.explanation: Total trees = 7 + 7 - 1 = 13.

questions.question_text: Find the odd one out: 121, 144, 169, 189, 196
questions.explanation: 121=11², 144=12², 169=13², 196=14². 189 is not a perfect square.

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym of 'LUCIDITY':
questions.explanation: 'Lucidity' denotes clarity of expression and intelligibility; closest to 'Clarity'.

questions.question_text: Choose the antonym of 'FERVENT':
questions.explanation: 'Fervent' means having or displaying passionate intensity. Its direct antonym is 'Apathetic' (indifferent, uncaring).

questions.question_text: Identify the sentence that correctly treats the collective noun 'board of directors':
options: The board of directors have approved the merger.
The board of directors has approved the merger.
The board of directors are approving the merger.
The board of directors were approved the merger.
questions.explanation: 'Board of directors' is treated as a collective noun acting as a single unified entity, requiring the singular verb 'has approved'.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: The startup founders were accused ___ misappropriating grant funding.
questions.explanation: The standard preposition paired with 'accuse' is 'of' (accused of doing something).

questions.question_text: What does the idiom 'to leave no stone unturned' mean?
options: To try every possible course of action in order to achieve something
questions.explanation: 'To leave no stone unturned' means to explore every conceivable avenue or opportunity thoroughly.

questions.question_text: Select the one-word substitution for: 'A person who speaks two languages fluently'
questions.explanation: A person who is able to speak two languages fluently is 'Bilingual'.

questions.question_text: An enterprise client demands a custom feature that directly violates user data security standards. As the tech lead, how do you respond?
options: Implement it secretly and ask the client not to mention it.
Respectfully decline the insecure implementation, explain the concrete cybersecurity hazards, and offer an alternative compliant architectural pattern that fulfills their business need.
Yell at the client for not caring about privacy.
questions.explanation: Consultative technical leadership requires holding firm on security while collaboratively providing an alternative compliant solution.

questions.question_text: You observe a senior developer taking credit for a sophisticated cache optimization algorithm designed and coded entirely by an associate developer. What should you do?
options: Stay silent because hierarchy always matters more than fairness.
In the next sprint review or team demo, publicly thank and attribute the associate developer for authoring the optimization algorithm.
Confront the senior developer angrily in the company cafeteria.
Send an anonymous complaint to the CEO.
questions.explanation: Proactively attributing contributions during team demonstrations restores fair credit positively without destructive conflict.

questions.question_text: You are given access to production analytics data for an investigation and notice salaries of company executives. What should you do?
options: Share the salary spreadsheet with your colleagues on WhatsApp.
Immediately close the unrelated data, report the over-permissive data leak to the data governance team, and adhere to strict confidentiality.
Use the numbers to demand an immediate raise.
questions.explanation: Confidentiality and reporting over-permissive access to data governance preserves institutional trust and security compliance.

questions.question_text: Your software patch inadvertently broke the payment gateway for 15 minutes during peak hours. How should the post-incident review be handled?
options: Identify which specific engineer pushed the button and penalize them.
Conduct a blameless postmortem focusing on why automated CI/CD guardrails failed to catch the regression, and implement automated canaries.
Sweep the incident under the rug since it was only 15 minutes.
questions.explanation: World-class tech organizations practice blameless postmortems to harden systemic automation rather than scapegoating individuals.

title: Soft Skill Assessment - Set 8
description: Assesses compound growth mathematics, logical analogies, concise professional writing, and agile team diplomacy.

questions.question_text: A sum of ₹25,000 invested at compound interest grows to ₹29,160 in 2 years. What is the annual rate of interest?
If 12 copies of a book cost ₹1,800, how much will 28 copies of the same book cost?
questions.explanation: Cost per copy = 1,800 / 12 = ₹150. Cost of 28 copies = 28 × 150 = ₹4,200.

questions.question_text: Two trains of lengths 140 m and 160 m run on parallel tracks in opposite directions at 40 km/h and 50 km/h respectively. In how many seconds will they completely cross each other?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 140 + 160 = 300 m. Relative speed = 40 + 50 = 90 km/h = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s. Time = 300 / 25 = 12 seconds.

questions.question_text: A contractor undertakes to build a road in 40 days and employs 25 men. After 24 days, he finds that only 1/3 of the road is completed. How many extra men must he employ to complete the work on schedule?
questions.explanation: Total work = 1. Work done in 24 days by 25 men = 1/3 => (25 × 24) / (1/3) = 1800. Remaining work = 2/3. Remaining time = 40 - 24 = 16 days. Let total men be M. (M × 16) / (2/3) = 1800 => 24M = 1800 => M = 75 men. Extra men needed = 75 - 25 = 50 men.

questions.question_text: A number when divided by 899 gives a remainder of 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 29?
questions.explanation: Since 899 is exactly divisible by 29 (899 = 29 × 31), the remainder when dividing by 29 is simply 63 mod 29 = 5.

questions.question_text: Three dice are thrown simultaneously. What is the probability of obtaining a total sum of 16?
questions.explanation: Total outcomes = 6³ = 216. Triplet sums to 16: (6,6,4) with 3 permutations, (6,5,5) with 3 permutations. Total favorable outcomes = 3 + 3 = 6. Probability = 6 / 216 = 1/36.

questions.question_text: The ratio between the present ages of A and B is 4:5. Six years hence, their ages will be in the ratio 5:6. What is the present age of B?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 4x and 5x. (4x + 6) / (5x + 6) = 5/6 => 24x + 36 = 25x + 30 => x = 6. B's present age = 5x = 30 years.

questions.question_text: A trader marks his goods at 25% above cost and allows a discount of 10% on the marked price. What is his net profit percentage?
Find the missing term: 10, 18, 28, 40, 54, 70, ?
If 'MONEY' is coded as 'PRQHB', how is 'CREDIT' coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3: C(3)+3=F, R(18)+3=U, E(5)+3=H, D(4)+3=G, I(9)+3=L, T(20)+3=W, yielding FUHGLW.

questions.question_text: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, 'He is the son of the only daughter of the father of my brother.' How is the man in the photograph related to the woman?
questions.explanation: Father of my brother = my father. The only daughter of my father = myself (the woman). The son of myself = my son.

questions.question_text: Statements: All buildings are houses. No house is an apartment. All apartments are flats. Which conclusion follows? I. No building is an apartment. II. Some flats are not houses.
questions.explanation: Since all buildings are houses and no house is an apartment, no building can be an apartment (I follows). Since all apartments are flats and no apartment is a house, the flats that are apartments cannot be houses (II follows). Both follow.

questions.question_text: GRAIN : SILO :: WATER : ?
questions.explanation: Grain is stored in a silo; water is stored in a reservoir.

questions.question_text: Starting from point X, a cyclist rides 8 km North, turns left and rides 6 km, then turns left again and rides 8 km. How far and in what direction is he from point X?
questions.explanation: The North and South legs cancel out. He is 6 km West of point X.

questions.question_text: Find the odd one out among the following cities: Paris, Berlin, Madrid, Sydney
questions.explanation: Paris (France), Berlin (Germany), and Madrid (Spain) are national capital cities; Sydney is not the capital of Australia (Canberra is).

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym of 'INDOLENT':
questions.explanation: 'Indolent' means wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy.

questions.question_text: Choose the antonym of 'AFFLUENT':
questions.explanation: 'Affluent' means possessing great wealth. Its direct antonym is 'Poor' (or destitute).

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank with the correct conditional form: If the team ___ earlier, they would have caught the regression before deployment.
questions.explanation: Third conditional (past counterfactual): 'If + past perfect (had tested), ... would have + past participle'.

questions.question_text: Select the correct idiom meaning 'to deal with a problem directly and boldly':
options: Take the bull by the horns
questions.explanation: 'Take the bull by the horns' means to confront a difficult situation directly and decisively.

questions.question_text: Select the word that correctly replaces the phrase: 'The practice of appointing relatives and friends to positions of power regardless of qualifications'
questions.explanation: 'Nepotism' is the practice among those with power or influence of favoring relatives or friends, especially by giving them jobs.

questions.question_text: Choose the correctly spelled word:
questions.explanation: 'Maintenance' is spelled with 'ten' in the middle, not 'tain'.

questions.question_text: A high-priority client sends an aggressive message on a weekend threatening contract cancellation due to a minor UI styling bug. What is the most appropriate action?
options: Send a prompt, courteous acknowledgment assuring them that their message is received, log the issue in the defect tracker, and notify the on-call engineer to review severity.
Reply angrily that weekends are protected personal time.
Issue a full contract refund without management approval.
questions.explanation: Professional client de-escalation balances reassurance and prompt acknowledgment while funneling the defect through official on-call triage.

questions.question_text: Your direct manager asks you to manipulate test benchmark figures in an executive board presentation to paint an overly optimistic roadmap picture. How do you respond?
options: Falsify the data as requested without questioning.
Politely decline to misrepresent metrics, provide the authentic data alongside a constructive remediation narrative, and uphold institutional integrity.
Leak the slides to the press.
Delete all the slides and resign.
questions.explanation: Ethical professionals maintain data veracity while offering constructive solutions to bridge gaps rather than compromising integrity.

questions.question_text: A new teammate joins your team remotely and feels isolated because most team members already know each other well. What can you do?

Assign them all your backlog bugs.
questions.explanation: Proactive remote onboarding and informal social touchpoints accelerate team integration and psychological safety.

Tell them to write both implementations from scratch.

questions.question_text: You discover that a senior salesperson promised a prospective client an impossible feature delivery within two weeks without consulting engineering. What should you do?
options: Stay silent and let the deployment fail on the promised date.
Organize an urgent alignment sync between Sales leadership and Engineering, present the realistic architectural timeline, and define an honest, phased delivery plan.
Angrily email the client that the salesperson lied to them.
Work 100 hours a week to try to deliver it regardless of code quality.
questions.explanation: Rapid cross-departmental alignment prevents client trust breakdowns and aligns commercial promises with engineering capacity.

questions.question_text: Your automated test suite has 15 flaky tests that fail intermittently without real bugs, slowing down team pull request merges. What is the best engineering course of action?

Quarantine the flaky tests, open an urgent tech-debt ticket to investigate concurrency or timing race conditions, and fix them systematically.
Tell developers to just re-run the CI pipeline until it passes by luck.
questions.explanation: Quarantining and fixing flaky tests restores developer confidence in CI while maintaining rigorous test coverage.

questions.question_text: In a client meeting, a client executive asks a direct technical question about database latency that you do not know the answer to. How should you respond?
options: Make up an impressive sounding statistic.
Transparently state that you do not have the exact metric at hand, but will verify with the infrastructure team and follow up in writing by end of day.
Look down at your phone and pretend not to hear.
Blame your teammate for not preparing the slide.
questions.explanation: Intellectual honesty and committing to a prompt, accurate follow-up commands far greater respect than fabricated answers.

questions.question_text: During code review, you notice a teammate has introduced a security antipattern that could allow SQL injection. How do you communicate this?
options: Publicly mock their code on Twitter.
Leave a clear, supportive comment explaining the vulnerability vector, cite the OWASP guideline, and provide a parameterized query code snippet as a concrete fix.
Approve the PR and wait for a hacker to exploit it.
Complain to the CTO that the developer should be fired.

description: Milestone assessment evaluating multi-step quantitative analytics, abstract reasoning, executive English, and strategic technical leadership.

A train 300 m long traveling at 90 km/h crosses another train 200 m long traveling in the opposite direction at 54 km/h. How many seconds do they take to cross each other completely?

questions.question_text: Introducing a woman, a man said, 'Her father is the only son of my father.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: 'The only son of my father' is the man himself. Since he is her father, the man is her father.

questions.question_text: Statements: All pens are books. All books are journals. All journals are papers. Which conclusion follows? I. All pens are papers. II. Some papers are pens.

questions.question_text: NEEDLE : THREAD :: PEN : ?

questions.question_text: In an exam, Rahul scored higher than Mohan but lower than Sohan. Rohan scored higher than Sohan. Who among them scored the highest?

questions.question_text: Choose the synonym of 'TACITURN':

questions.question_text: Complete the idiom: 'To throw in the ___' means to admit defeat.

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: She was surprised ___ the high throughput of the distributed message queue.
questions.explanation: The standard preposition pairing is 'surprised at' (or 'surprised by'). In formal entrance tests, 'surprised at' is the benchmark answer.

questions.question_text: A major production outage is ongoing, and multiple stakeholders are flooding the engineer on-call with panic messages in several Slack channels. What should the engineering lead do?

questions.question_text: You discover that an open-source library used by your application has a severe zero-day security vulnerability. What is the proper sequence of steps?

Assess exposure, verify if an official patched version exists, test the update in a sandbox staging environment, deploy to production, and monitor.
Rewrite the entire open-source library from scratch overnight.
Uninstall the library and leave the feature broken.

questions.question_text: A new developer joins your team and asks questions that you consider basic. How do you respond?
options: Tell them they should know this before getting hired.

Forward their questions to management to prove they are unqualified.

questions.question_text: Your company is shifting from a monolith to microservices, and several senior engineers resist the change due to comfort with legacy tooling. How do you lead through this transition?

questions.question_text: Select the one-word substitution for: 'A person who hates or distrusts humankind'

questions.question_text: A key client reports that a feature released yesterday is causing latency in their internal dashboard. What is the immediate professional step?

questions.question_text: You notice that a colleague is feeling overwhelmed due to personal family emergencies. What is the kind and professional action?

questions.question_text: In a 100 m race, A covers the distance in 36 seconds and B in 45 seconds. By what distance does A defeat B?

questions.question_text: In how many different ways can the letters of the word 'CORPORATION' be arranged so that the vowels always come together?
questions.explanation: Vowels in CORPORATION: O, O, A, I, O (5 vowels: 3 O's, 1 A, 1 I). Consonants: C, R, P, R, T, N (6 consonants: 2 R's). Treat the 5 vowels as 1 block. Total units = 6 consonants + 1 block = 7 units. Arranging 7 units with 2 R's = 7! / 2! = 5040 / 2 = 2520 ways. Arranging the 5 vowels with 3 O's = 5! / 3! = 120 / 6 = 20 ways. Total arrangements = 2520 × 20 = 50,400.

questions.question_text: The ratio of two numbers is 3:4 and their HCF is 4. What is their LCM?

questions.question_text: A tank is filled in 5 hours by three pipes A, B and C. Pipe C is twice as fast as B and B is twice as fast as A. How many hours would pipe A alone take to fill the tank?

questions.question_text: The ratio between the length and perimeter of a rectangular plot is 1:3. What is the ratio between the length and breadth of the plot?
